dedupe_keys.name: combicsp a python routine for dynamic modeling of concentrating solar power plants

description: CombiCSP: A python routine for dynamic modeling of concentrating solar power plants is a software tool described in the paper "CombiCSP: A python routine for dynamic modeling of concentrating solar power plants" in Software Impacts (Elsevier, 2022), produced by Georgios E. Arnaoutakis, Nikolaos Papadakis, Dimitris Al. Katsaprakakis. The abstract could not be read from the open sources used, so the contents are taken from the title. Coverage: not tied to a place or time; the tool is generic. The linked page gives the code or the package; nothing was installed or run, and the repository link comes from a web search for the article, not from the article page. Licence: not stated (no licence on the Software Impacts record read on 2026-10-01; check the repository). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's title and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support dynamic simulation and annual yield estimates of concentrating solar power plants. Related: the paper is the Software Impacts article 10.1016/j.simpa.2022.100367.
